responsibility: This target header defines the merged NetBSD ELF configuration for sparc and sparc64, including optional bi-arch operation. It supplies NetBSD/SPARC preprocessor builtins, type and label-format overrides, assembler and linker specs, 32/64-bit CC1 and link-architecture selection logic, default target masks and code model for 64-bit defaults, multilib defaults, and long-double sizing rules so one SPARC backend can match NetBSD’s 32-bit and 64-bit ELF ABIs.
